summary: Monitoring policies is simpler with one form and personas you manage yourself.

new.title: One simple CA Policy Analyzer form
new.text: Pick a new or existing monitor, choose policies and a sign-in period, then analyze now or save it as a monitor. Less common options sit under More options.

new.title: Manage your own personas
new.text: Create, rename and delete personas, and add policies or name rules to them. A policy can be in several personas or none, and monitors follow a rename.

new.title: Add policies to monitors from Conditional Access
new.text: Each policy shows the monitors it is in. On the Conditional Access page, select policies and add them to or remove them from a monitor.

fixes.title: Persona groups sort as intended
fixes.text: Global comes first, then the personas A to Z, then policies without a persona.
